mission: Self-host Fraunces and IBM Plex Mono via next/font/local so the staging web build never fetches Google Fonts (web only; no API, migration, collector or data change; no collector rollout)

impacts.reason: Replace next/font/google Fraunces and IBM_Plex_Mono with next/font/local using the committed latin-subset woff2 files Google Fonts served (byte-identical to the previous build's emitted assets; same CSS variables, weights, styles, display). Comment updates in globals.css and chartExport.ts. Builds with fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com blocked; rendering, layout and chart export verified unchanged. Vercel frontend build only; no services/, packages/, deploy/, scripts/ or workflow change, no collector rollout or migration requested. Expected 0 collector deployment records.
Comment-only update: layout.tsx now uses next/font/local.

SIL OFL 1.1 licence texts (unmodified, google/fonts) next to the fonts, font provenance README with hashes and the unmodified-upstream alternative, and typography docs updated from next/font/google to next/font/local.
